In the context of national clinical quality databases, data availability is a foundational requirement for calculating performance indicators. Currently, there are specific limitations regarding the integration of laboratory data into these registries. [[den-nationale-labdatabank-dnl|Den Nationale Labdatabank (DNL)]] does not presently have data available within the national quality databases [^src1]. However, there are explicit plans for future integration: once this laboratory data becomes accessible, it will be incorporated into the indicator calculations for the [[akut-kirurgi-databasen|Akut Kirurgi Databasen]] (AKDB) [^src1]. This documented instance highlights an ongoing dependency on external data pipelines to fully evaluate and report on acute surgical quality.

## Claims

- DNL har aktuelt ikke data til rådighed i de nationale kvalitetsdatabaser, men når data bliver tilgængelige, vil de indgå i indikatorberegningen i AKDB [^src1] (den-nationale-labdatabank-dnl, akut-kirurgi-databasen)
